core_obligations: The author constructs Legendrian pairs adapted to a pseudo-Anosov open book and controls holomorphic strips/cobordism continuation using the original fractional-twist condition. Exponential growth of the corresponding filtered chord-homotopy classes forces exponential Reeb-chord growth and hence positive topological entropy for every contact form defining the contact structure.
